passage:
A shopping app kept recommending baby products to a man who had only bought a gift for his cousin's child once.
At first, he laughed. Then he became annoyed. The app had guessed too much from too little information.
In technology class, students discussed recommendation systems. They learned that algorithms use patterns, but patterns can be wrong or incomplete.
One student said, "The app thinks it knows him, but it only knows his clicks."
That sentence stayed with the class.
Digital systems can be useful, but they do not understand people the way people understand people. A person is more than data points.
